english.note: Use this when stressing that someone goes their own way and disregards what other people expect.
Use this when someone deliberately follows their own way and ignores the expected norm.

examples.english: They have always been headstrong and never care what other people think.
examples.traditional: 佢一向我行我素，完全唔理人哋點睇。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 ngo5 hang4 ngo5 sou3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 jan4 dei6 dim2 tai2

examples.english: They have always been wayward, doing whatever they want and ignoring what other people think.
